description: Client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that hides chosen ModelEngine model pieces by their item_model id, by cancelling their rendering.

mods.name: Hide Models
mods.description: Hides chosen ModelEngine model pieces client-side by their item_model id - e.g. a mount's head, or a whole pet - by cancelling their rendering rather than removing the entities.

mods.name: Hide Models
mods.description:
Hides chosen ModelEngine model pieces client-side by their item_model id - a mount's head that
blocks your view, a pet that follows you around - by cancelling their rendering rather than
removing the entities. Hitboxes, interactions and the server's view of the world are untouched.

releases.notes:
Hidden models can now be saved as profiles that you switch on and off, share by copy and paste, or tie to a server so they switch themselves when you join.

Additional changes:
 - Shift + Keybind works as a toggle to hide/show models
 - Mod Menu & NeoForge mods list handling
 - The model in front is listed first & marked in the GUI
 - Wynncraft server model handling introduced (limited functionality)
 - Models that disappeared will still be listed in the Nearby section for 30s

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Simuciokas/hidemodels/compare/v2.0.1...v2.1.0
